provenance.source: Alberta Personal Income Tax Act; CRA T4127 Chapter 8 (Alberta); Alberta Budget 2025 (new 8% bracket)
provenance.notes: Brackets and BPA are the 2025 amounts indexed at 2.0%. Alberta has suspended indexation in some past years, so the 2026 indexation is UNCONFIRMED - verify before shipping. This file is the single place to correct it.

brackets.legalRef: Alberta Personal Income Tax Act s. 6.1
brackets.note: The 8% bracket introduced for 2025 applies to income. Non-refundable credits continue to be valued at 10%, so creditRate deliberately differs from the lowest bracket rate.

medical.note: The Alberta threshold differs slightly from the federal one. The federal figure is used as an approximation pending verification.

omissions: The Alberta Child and Family Benefit is a benefit, not part of tax payable, and is not modelled.
